rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a telephone device, including a phone or handset in ordinary contexts.

example.english: My telephone has run out of battery.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for calling someone by telephone or making a phone call.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5
